notes.title: Tales & Lore UPDATE! + New Companion Events & Soundtrack
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303099/a62ddcdf1e2f59a287c345844dc2a5678b28af9d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! It has been a busy few weeks, but your favorite [b]Gothic developer is back in action[/b] and has brought you a fresh update with brand new content. This time focused on lore and some friendly interactions you can get with two of your companions: [b]Abyss[/b] and [b]Rozen[/b]. [/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/fbFqxxfj/CG-ROZEN1.png"][/img][b]The mythical girl that comes from the deeps of the Ocean[/b] and the [b]Nymph who turned into a nurse to help others.[/b] These mysterious companions had their quests inside the game already, however, they didn't exactly have a proper post-quest interaction at the same levels other character had. [b]Now they do,[/b] both with a more mysterious tone as well that widens the [b]lore[/b] of the in-game world. To highlight the importance of these two scenes, [b]2 new soundtracks have been added[/b] to the game. Completely original and composed by our witty composer [i]Devil Mistakes[/i]. These tracks are: [i]A Drink for Sorrows[/i] & [i]Nocturna I Am respectively[/i].[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/d1yHnLWM/CG-ABYSS1.png"][/img]Nonetheless, I know some of you are the hardboiled [i]Casanovas[/i]; and need your dosis of romance administrated even if subtle. For this reason, in this Update is [b]also included an expansion our frivolous Helzian, Meinhard.[/b] His scenes are now expanded [b]with new illustrations[/b], and some of the old ones got reworked to closer resemble his new Elvish appearance. Not only that, but [b]new dialogues to the scene got added so everything fits inside a single enhanced whole.[/b] For veteran players, an option was included to re-experience the scene [b]without needed to re-load[/b] an earlier save.[/p][p]I take the opportunity to invite you to our [b][url="https://discord.gg/CFSzDNhVGH"]Discord Server[/url][/b][url="https://discord.gg/CFSzDNhVGH"].[/url] Many great ideas for UPDATES have come from here, especially from the [b]channel[/b] dedicated to discussion of the game. You can also get pinged immediately for [b]fresh news[/b] before anyone else.[/p][p]With no more to add, I leave you with the summary of new features:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Interaction Scene with Rozen the Nymph. [/b]Available after completing her quest and advancing your relation with her. With new dialogues and illustrations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Interaction Scene with Abyss the Sea Dweller. [/b]Likewise available after completing her quest, with new dialogues, illustrations and unique soundtrack.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Meinhard Scene and illustrations. [/b]To our vanity loving Helzian, old illustrations got enhanced and new ones were added. Along with an option to re-experience the scene without need to load for players who already completed it.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]Total for 25+ New Illustrations added for all scenes combined.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]2 New Original Soundtracks.[/b] Composed by our dear musician Devil Mistakes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All New Illustrations are unlockable in the Codex Memoriam.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Retro-compatibility with Previous Saves for Veteran Players.[/b] No need to start again if you already did the Companions' quests. Talking with them again should suffice. [/p][/*][/list][p]For now, that's all! I hope you enjoy it. As always if you like the game, leaving your review on Steam greatly helps it.[/p][p]See you later~.[/p]

notes.title: SUMMER UPDATE! New CGs + Romance Option
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303099/6e7666cbe060174baaa1897a082a903d53c5d857.png"][/img][/p][p][b]THE SUMMER STEAM SALE IS HERE, AND WITH IT NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME![/b][/p][p]Hi everyone. It's been a hot minute since the last update for the game; 3 weeks to be exact. I apologies to all of you for the waiting and silence. But we're back at the table with a fresh update for all players. So let's get to it right away.[/p][p]-[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/13Vjg98b/CG-KAZIA000.png"][/img]
[b]A bit of background: [/b]When I first started to make this game, I didn't thought so many people would care about CGs, romance scenes and character interactions. I had the idea people come to these games to unravel horror aspects and hidden secrets; of course, horror, side quests and RPG systems are still a major focus in the game, and will remain so. But after seeing the amazing reception the building of friendship and bonding options character interactions had, along with praising for more complex CGs, I decided to go back and add [i]new, better and more polished options[/i] for the aforementioned features.[/p][p]This can be seen [b]in the CGs scenes of the game.[/b] These are a reward the player gets for completing companions' quests and progressing their relationship. At the beginning they were smaller center pieces with different slideway images. They were quite catchy and I know is the reason many of you decided to give an opportunity to the game. But now... [i]Oh boy[/i], now the CGs are full-blown illustrated images that fill the game's screen completely in most cases. Not only they're fully illustrated but they have variations as the player progress in the scene to make them more engaging and interesting.[/p][p]One thing I'm proud of is that today many games decide to go for a [i]gacha-style[/i] mode of interaction with characters. Where the players have to wait days, weeks and even months to get more dialogue or scenes with their favorite characters. [b]RAVENSBURG allows ALL players to access[/b] its content and scenes within the game itself, with only exploration, side quest and story progression needed to unlock it.[/p][p]-[/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/HshNsJkQ/CG-KAZIA00.png"][/img]
With this in mind is how the following update is presented. Many interactions were added previously, but a very important one was still missing. The one for the game's deuteragonist and player's always loyal companion. That's right, [b]Kazia's romance is finally here, unlockable to all players. [/b]That said, I can finally list the features of this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Romance with Kazia Added. [/b]I won't reveal how or when exactly you can romance Kazia, All I'm going to say is you have to progress enough in RAVENSBURG's main quest. And that you might receive hints if you explore the Mansion's room enough to talk with different characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More than 20+ CGs Added.[/b] These include variations and changes as the scene progress. These are some of my most detailed and worked CGs to date, even including the more recently updated ones to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retro-compability with Old Saves.[/b] I always try to let old players return to the game and play the new content from their own saves, this is not the exception. If you have progressed enough in the story, you will be able to access the new romance as you wish.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main story CG in the Bathtub was upgraded with Detail.[/b] As a way to celebrate the new content, I decided to go back and enhance this scene part of the main quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All of the new CGs are added to the Codex Memoriam/Gallery.[/b] Including the enhanced one previously mentioned.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Visual Bugs & Typos Fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]I don't have much else to add, so I'll be leaving it here. As final reminder, I want you to know much of these updates have been given thanks to [b]players' feedback.[/b] So please, if you have any don't be ashamed to give it to me on Steam Forums, Discord, Twitter/X or anywhere else you want. You can also leave a [b]Steam Review[/b] on the main page, which not only works as feedback, but greatly helps the game and other people who might be on the fence to find it.[/p][p]Hope you enjoy it, and until next time.[/p]

notes.title: 🩸 Patch: The Map & the Chapel
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/YqwhfQ5f/Location-Icons1.png[/img]

Hi everyone. Apologies for being silent these past days. Blackouts were giving trouble, and while vampires can see in the dark, they can't escape the need for electricity. As compensation, here's a new update:

[list]
[*] The map of RAVENSBURG has been reshaped elegantly. Now you can navigate discovered locations using buttons without the need for a mouse. I know owners of a gamepads/controllers will be happy with this since some of them requested it to me.
[*] New, brand and unique icons has been given to each location. Making them easier to recognize and more flavour flour to the eyes!
[*] New Fast Travel Point added inside Ravenstein Mansion's Chapel. Those that explore the mansion will be recompensated with a more convenient travelling point (if activated!).
[*] Nox skill bug fixed. Now the spell properly absorbs life from enemies when used, and its SP cost has been readjusted accordingly. 
[*] Minor dialogue improvement to Lucille's Shop.
[/list]
This follows the previous big Villain Update, which added new quests and companions. Remember to share the game with friends. And who knows, there might be additional CGs soon!

notes.title: Villain Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rFq2zGSW/VILLAIN-UPDATE2.png[/img]
[b]The Villain Update is finally here![/b]
Introducing new companions, quests, locations with puzzles, powerful new bosses, and polished CGs for each new character! This is the big update promised in a previous announcement; and now it's live.

Here’s a [b]spoiler-free[/b] breakdown of what’s new:
[list]
[*] [b]New Map: The Labyrinth of Urth.[/b] A cursed and sinister maze said to hold a powerful treasure at its heart.
[*] [b]New Map: Apartment 66.[/b] What horrors lurk in the foul, shadowed halls of this decaying building?
[*] [b]New Map: The Cloister of St. Basil.[/b] This forgotten medieval cloister hides a dangerous secret, guarded by three mysterious statues.
[*] Three Main Villainesses Are Now Recruitable Companions: [b]Cassandra, Cristina, and Foix[/b] can now join your party!
[*] Each with her own unique set of abilities
[*] Each with a fully original companion side quest
[*] Each with multiple large, fully illustrated & more detailed CGs
[*] New Missions Focused on Puzzle Solving and Investigation
[*] New Dialogue Reactions when you bring the Villainesses in your Party
[*] Three Powerful New Bosses
[*] New Items Added
[*] Various Minor Improvements and Fixes[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FHfWK1n3/SCREEN-FOIX3.png[/img]
[b]Thanks to all of you, RAVENSBURG has now surpassed 10 reviews on Steam![/b] If you enjoyed the game and haven’t left a review yet, doing so on the main page really helps a lot. 

Don't forget you can always follow more closely on [url=http://twitter.com/LilianDuleroux]Twitter/X[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/CFSzDNhVGH]Discord.[/url] For bug reports, please use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3314710/discussions/0/598522350980361062/]Bug Thread[/url], and for feature requests or suggestions, you can post in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3314710/discussions/0/598522350980361318/]Suggestion Thread[/url].

This update was designed to be retro-compatible with existing save files for players who’ve already completed the game. It’s aimed at mid-to-high levels. However, some compatibility issues may still occur. If you experience strange behavior, try leaving and re-entering the affected map; it may help. Your patience and understanding are deeply appreciated!
